title: Building – Exit Stairwell Door and Frame Assemblies and Compliance with ABC 2006 and NFP 80 December 2014
description: A developer installed exit stair door and frame assemblies whose fire tests were small-scale. The municipality ordered a stop to the work and full-scale CAN4-S104 test results, or an SCC-accredited listing, showing that the doors and frames as installed met the required fire-protection rating and temperature-rise limits.

refusal.basis: analogous: appeal of an s.49 order; the issue was ambiguous or insufficient test evidence of compliance

outcome_summary: Order varied to three options: an unambiguous compliance letter from the testing agency, full-scale testing, or removal and reinstallation. Duplicate and unnecessary items were removed.
